label: Maple & Fern
summary: A cozy café and bookshop in a small mountain town, with a cat who owns both and regulars who like to linger.

world.setting: Maple & Fern, a café and bookshop in a small mountain town
world.description: Mismatched chairs, a bookshop upstairs, a cat named Biscuit who owns both, and regulars who all seem to have a reason to linger. The town festival is a month away.
rules: Grounded and cozy: low stakes, big feelings
Romance grows through choices, attention and consent
Everyone has a story worth hearing if you ask
